name: Seobility
summary: SEO software suite with website audit, rank monitoring, backlink monitoring, uptime checks and AI visibility tracking, with a free Basic account and a 14-day trial on paid plans.
best_for: small businesses, freelancers and agencies that want a website audit, rank tracking and backlink monitoring in one suite, with a free account to start
skip_if: you need to track thousands of keywords without add-on packages, want prices without VAT shown first, or want a tool we have tested on a paid plan ourselves
honest_knock: Prices are shown plus VAT, and extra keywords and projects are billed as monthly add-ons. The AI visibility tracking is marked Beta. We have not paid for a plan, so audit accuracy is untested by us.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on seobility.net/pricing, euros, plus VAT) Basic: free, no time limit, 1 project, 10 keywords, 100 pages per crawl, limited website audit. Premium: 59.90 a month, or 575.04 a year (20% off), 3 projects, 25,000 pages per crawl, 300 keywords. Professional: 99.90 a month, or 959.04 a year, 7 projects, 50,000 pages, 700 keywords. Agency: 209.90 a month, or 2,015.04 a year, 20 projects, 100,000 pages, 2,000 keywords. The paid plans have a 14-day free trial, cancel any time. Extra projects 4.90 to 14.90 and extra 100 keywords 6.90 to 10.90 a month. We have not paid for a plan.

schema_offer.description: Premium, per month plus VAT, billed monthly; 575.04 a year billed annually; Professional 99.90 and Agency 209.90 a month; Basic is free. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-17.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: Prices are shown plus VAT, and extra keywords and projects are billed as monthly add-ons.

compare_with.name: Elite Site Optimizer
compare_with.why: Elite Site Optimizer is priced in dollars from $49 a month with a 14-day trial, while Seobility has a permanent free account and euro pricing. Run the same site through both trials and compare what each audit flags.
